'''Samantha''' (Japanese: '''サヨリ''' ''Sayori'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG105|Once in a Mawile]]'' when the group was traveling across [[Izabe Island]].

She is a performer who does routines with ribbons. Samantha owns a {{p|Mawile}} that has many crushes, as it fell for {{an|Brock}}'s {{TP|Brock|Lombre}}. Lombre was uninterested, much to the dismay of Brock, who wanted to use the attraction to get closer to Samantha. After [[Evolution|evolving]] into Ludicolo, it saw Mawile in a new light, but by that time, Mawile had already moved on to a {{p|Psyduck}}.

For some reason, Samantha had a [[Water Stone]] in her [[Bag|backpack]], which was what allowed Lombre to evolve.

|desc={{p|Mawile}} is Samantha's only known Pokémon. It was always seen [[Walking Pokémon|outside its Poké Ball]].

It fell in love with {{an|Brock}}'s {{p|Lombre}}, but Lombre did not show a mutual interest. In turn, Mawile did not reciprocate {{AP|Corphish}}'s own feelings for it. After Lombre evolved into a {{TP|Brock|Ludicolo}}, Mawile lost interest despite Ludicolo changing its ways. Instead, Mawile fell in love with a passing {{pkmn|Trainer}}'s {{p|Psyduck}}. Mawile was also shown to be a very elegant dancer as it was seen practicing with Samantha for a performance.

Mawile's known moves are {{m|Bite}}, {{m|Solar Beam}}, and {{m|Focus Punch}}.}}
